name: r12-l-e4-toeplitz-gate
author: solx-loop
description: H50 gate. A Toeplitz depthwise 7x7 conv on tcgen05 kind::f16 runs at 60 clk per N=112 MMA in isolation, but in a full conv kernel it is shared-memory-bandwidth bound: 7.5 KB of operand reads per 60 clk is about 125 B/clk per SM. The best full kernel (conv + fp16 d write) runs 155 us at 64,96 and 57.8 us at 32,128 rented, against gate lines of 100 / 25 us. The shipped code is the r0 anchor; the probe kernel is archived behind #if 0.
